issues.advice: Look for a shared cause: a broken module, a full filesystem, one user's retry loop (waste_report shows repeats).
issues.subject: last 24 h

notes: Read-only checks over scontrol, squeue and the last day of sacct. Stockouts show up as slow boots, NODE_FAIL/BOOT_FAIL or launch-failed holds; the slurm-gcp resume log on the controller has the GCP error text.

commands: bash -c 'if sacct --helpformat | grep -qw Restarts; then SLURM_TIME_FORMAT=%s exec sacct -n -P --noconvert -o JobIDRaw,User,Partition,State,Reason,ExitCode,NodeList,NNodes,Submit,Start,End,ElapsedRaw,TotalCPU,AllocTRES,MaxRSS,Restarts,JobName "$@"; fi; set -o pipefail; SLURM_TIME_FORMAT=%s sacct -n -P --noconvert -o JobIDRaw,User,Partition,State,Reason,ExitCode,NodeList,NNodes,Submit,Start,End,ElapsedRaw,TotalCPU,AllocTRES,MaxRSS,JobName "$@" | sed '\''s/|/||/15'\''' clusterwand -a -S now-1days
